SELECT (institutions.id)::text AS id,
    institutions.slug,
    institutions.name,
    institutions.description AS snippet,
    'Institution'::text AS entity_type,
    '/institutions'::text AS base_route,
    institutions.search_vector,
    COALESCE(institutions.search_boost, 10) AS rank_boost,
    concat_ws(' '::text, institutions.name, institutions.short_name, institutions.official_name, array_to_string(institutions.aliases, ' '::text), array_to_string(institutions.common_misspellings, ' '::text), array_to_string(institutions.former_names, ' '::text)) AS match_text
   FROM institutions
  WHERE (institutions.is_active = true)
UNION ALL
 SELECT (leaders.id)::text AS id,
    leaders.slug,
    leaders.full_name AS name,
    leaders.bio AS snippet,
    'Leader'::text AS entity_type,
    '/leaders'::text AS base_route,
    leaders.search_vector,
    5 AS rank_boost,
    leaders.full_name AS match_text
   FROM leaders
  WHERE (leaders.is_active = true)
UNION ALL
 SELECT officials.id,
    officials.id AS slug,
    officials.full_name AS name,
    officials.bio AS snippet,
    'Official'::text AS entity_type,
    '/officials'::text AS base_route,
    officials.search_vector,
    8 AS rank_boost,
    concat_ws(' '::text, officials.full_name, officials.bio) AS match_text
   FROM officials
  WHERE (officials.is_active = true)
UNION ALL
 SELECT (counties.id)::text AS id,
    counties.slug,
    counties.name,
    NULL::text AS snippet,
    'County'::text AS entity_type,
    '/counties'::text AS base_route,
    counties.search_vector,
    6 AS rank_boost,
    concat_ws(' '::text, counties.name, counties.headquarters, counties.region) AS match_text
   FROM counties
  WHERE (counties.is_active = true)
UNION ALL
 SELECT (constituencies.id)::text AS id,
    constituencies.slug,
    constituencies.name,
    NULL::text AS snippet,
    'Constituency'::text AS entity_type,
    '/counties'::text AS base_route,
    constituencies.search_vector,
    4 AS rank_boost,
    constituencies.name AS match_text
   FROM constituencies
UNION ALL
 SELECT (wards.id)::text AS id,
    wards.slug,
    wards.name,
    NULL::text AS snippet,
    'Ward'::text AS entity_type,
    '/counties'::text AS base_route,
    wards.search_vector,
    3 AS rank_boost,
    wards.name AS match_text
   FROM wards
UNION ALL
 SELECT (political_parties.id)::text AS id,
    (political_parties.id)::text AS slug,
    political_parties.name,
    NULL::text AS snippet,
    'Political Party'::text AS entity_type,
    '/politics/political-parties'::text AS base_route,
    political_parties.search_vector,
    4 AS rank_boost,
    political_parties.name AS match_text
   FROM political_parties;

SELECT c.id AS county_id,
    c.slug AS county_slug,
    c.name AS county_name,
    c.headquarters,
    c.region,
    c.website_url,
    c.main_economic_activities,
    gov.full_name AS governor_name,
    gov.slug AS governor_slug,
    dep_gov.full_name AS deputy_governor_name,
    dep_gov.slug AS deputy_governor_slug,
    sen.full_name AS senator_name,
    sen.slug AS senator_slug,
    w_rep.full_name AS women_representative_name,
    w_rep.slug AS women_representative_slug
   FROM ((((counties c
     LEFT JOIN leaders gov ON (((gov.current_county = c.name) AND (gov.title = 'Governor'::text) AND (gov.is_active = true))))
     LEFT JOIN leaders dep_gov ON (((dep_gov.current_county = c.name) AND (dep_gov.title = 'Deputy Governor'::text) AND (dep_gov.is_active = true))))
     LEFT JOIN leaders sen ON (((sen.current_county = c.name) AND (sen.title = 'Senator'::text) AND (sen.is_active = true))))
     LEFT JOIN leaders w_rep ON (((w_rep.current_county = c.name) AND ((w_rep.title = 'Women Representative'::text) OR (w_rep.title = 'Woman Representative'::text)) AND (w_rep.is_active = true))));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bulk_insert_polling_stations(station_data jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.polling_stations_2022 (
        slug, county_id, constituency_id, ward_id, county_code, constituency_code, ward_code,
        reg_centre_code, reg_centre_name, polling_station_code, name, stream_number, registered_voters_2022
    )
    SELECT 
        -- 1. Generate perfectly clean slugs (removes spaces, symbols, and double hyphens)
        LOWER(TRIM(BOTH '-' FROM REGEXP_REPLACE(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                CONCAT(
                    item->>'county_name', '-', 
                    item->>'const_name', '-', 
                    item->>'ward_name', '-', 
                    item->>'name', '-stream-', 
                    (SUBSTRING(item->>'polling_station_code' FROM 14 FOR 2))::INTEGER
                ), 
                '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-', 'g'
            ), 
            '-+', '-', 'g'
        ))),
        w.county_id,
        w.constituency_id,
        w.id AS ward_id,
        w.county_code,
        w.constituency_code,
        w.ward_code,
        (item->>'reg_centre_code')::TEXT,
        (item->>'reg_centre_name')::TEXT,
        (item->>'polling_station_code')::TEXT,
        (item->>'name')::TEXT,
        (SUBSTRING(item->>'polling_station_code' FROM 14 FOR 2))::INTEGER AS stream_number,
        (item->>'registered_voters_2022')::INTEGER
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(station_data) AS item
    -- 2. Fast Indexed Dynamic Join mapping
    INNER JOIN public.wards w ON 
        w.county_code = (SUBSTRING(item->>'polling_station_code' FROM 1 FOR 3))::INTEGER
        AND w.constituency_code = SUBSTRING(item->>'polling_station_code' FROM 4 FOR 3)
        AND w.ward_code = SUBSTRING(item->>'polling_station_code' FROM 7 FOR 4)
    -- 3. Prevent duplicate insertion errors
    ON CONFLICT (polling_station_code) DO NOTHING; 
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cg_current_user_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid()
      and p.is_admin = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cg_document_sections_search_vector_refresh()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  new.search_document :=
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(new.heading,'')), 'B') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(new.body_text,'')), 'D');
  return new;
end $function$

      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(new.title,'')), 'A') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(new.short_title,'')), 'A') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(new.summary,'')), 'B') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(new.description,'')), 'C') ||

end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cg_escape_legal_html(p_text text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$
  select replace(
           replace(
             replace(
               replace(
                 replace(p_text, '&', '&'),
                 '<', '<'
               ),
               '>', '>'
             ),
             '"', '"'
           ),
           '''', '''
         );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prepare_gazette_notice_search()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  NEW.content_text :=
    btrim(
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(COALESCE(NEW.content_html, ''), '<[^>]+>', ' ', 'g'),
        '\s+',
        ' ',
        'g'
      )
    );

  NEW.search_document :=
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', COALESCE(NEW.title, '')), 'A')
    || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(NEW.notice_number::text, '')), 'A')
    || setweight(to_tsvector('english', COALESCE(NEW.act_referenced, '')), 'B')
    || setweight(to_tsvector('english', COALESCE(NEW.notice_type, '')), 'B')
    || setweight(to_tsvector('english', COALESCE(NEW.content_text, '')), 'C');

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_constitution(p_query text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(result_type text, result_id uuid, number_label text, title text, snippet text, href text, rank real)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with q as (
    select websearch_to_tsquery('english', nullif(trim(p_query),'')) as tsq
  ),
  exact_article as (
    select
      'article'::text,
      a.id,
      ('Article ' || a.article_number)::text,
      a.title,
      left(a.body_text, 280),
      ('/constitution/article/' || a.article_number)::text,
      100::real
    from constitution_articles a
    where trim(p_query) ~* '^(article\\s*)?[0-9]{1,3}(\\s*\\([^)]+\\))*$'
      and a.article_number = nullif(regexp_replace(trim(p_query), '^.*?([0-9]{1,3}).*$', '\\1'), '')::integer
  ),
  article_search as (
    select
      'article'::text,
      a.id,
      ('Article ' || a.article_number)::text,
      a.title,
      ts_headline('english', a.body_text, q.tsq, 'MaxWords=34, MinWords=15')::text,
      ('/constitution/article/' || a.article_number)::text,
      ts_rank_cd(a.search_document, q.tsq)::real
    from constitution_articles a, q
    where q.tsq is not null and a.search_document @@ q.tsq
  ),
  schedule_search as (
    select
      'schedule'::text,
      s.id,
      s.schedule_label,
      s.title,
      ts_headline('english', s.body_text, q.tsq, 'MaxWords=34, MinWords=15')::text,
      ('/constitution/schedules/' || s.slug)::text,
      ts_rank_cd(s.search_document, q.tsq)::real
    from constitution_schedules s, q
    where q.tsq is not null and s.search_document @@ q.tsq
  )
  select
    combined.result_type,
    combined.result_id,
    combined.number_label,
    combined.title,
    combined.snippet,
    combined.href,
    combined.search_rank
  from (
    select * from exact_article
    union all
    select * from article_search
    union all
    select * from schedule_search
  ) combined(
    result_type,
    result_id,
    number_label,
    title,
    snippet,
    href,
    search_rank
  )
  order by combined.search_rank desc, combined.number_label asc
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit,30),100));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_documents(p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_category_slug text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_type_slug text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_topic_slug text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_institution_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_year_from integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_year_to integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, short_title text, slug text, summary text, publication_date date, document_year integer, status text, publisher_text text, category_name text, category_slug text, type_name text, type_slug text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$

with filtered as (

  select distinct
    d.*,

    dc.name as category_name,
    dc.slug as category_slug,

    dt.name as type_name,
    dt.slug as type_slug

  from public.documents d

  left join public.document_types dt
    on dt.id = d.document_type_id

  left join public.document_categories dc
    on dc.id = dt.category_id

  left join public.document_topic_links dtl
    on dtl.document_id = d.id

  left join public.document_topics topic
    on topic.id = dtl.topic_id

  where
    d.published_at is not null
    and d.status <> 'Draft'

    and (
      p_category_slug is null
      or dc.slug = p_category_slug
    )

    and (
      p_type_slug is null
      or dt.slug = p_type_slug
    )

    and (
      p_topic_slug is null
      or topic.slug = p_topic_slug
    )

    and (
      p_institution_id is null
      or d.primary_institution_id = p_institution_id
    )

    and (
      p_status is null
      or d.status = p_status
    )

    and (
      p_year_from is null
      or d.document_year >= p_year_from
    )

    and (
      p_year_to is null
      or d.document_year <= p_year_to
    )

    and (
      nullif(trim(p_query), '') is null

      or d.search_document
        @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', p_query)

      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.document_sections s
        where
          s.document_id = d.id
          and s.search_document
            @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', p_query)
      )

      or d.title ilike '%' || p_query || '%'
    )
)

select
  f.id,
  f.title,
  f.short_title,
  f.slug,
  f.summary,
  f.publication_date,
  f.document_year,
  f.status,
  f.publisher_text,

  f.category_name,
  f.category_slug,

  f.type_name,
  f.type_slug,

  count(*) over() as total_count

from filtered f

order by

  case
    when p_sort = 'oldest'
    then f.publication_date
  end asc nulls last,

  case
    when p_sort = 'recently-added'
    then f.created_at
  end desc,

  case
    when p_sort = 'recently-updated'
    then f.updated_at
  end desc,

  case
    when p_sort = 'a-z'
    then lower(f.title)
  end asc,

  case
    when p_sort not in (
      'oldest',
      'recently-added',
      'recently-updated',
      'a-z'
    )
    then f.publication_date
  end desc nulls last,

  f.title asc

limit greatest(
  1,
  least(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 100)
)

offset greatest(
  coalesce(p_offset, 0),
  0
);

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_gazette_notices(search_query text, filter_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, filter_issue_number integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, result_limit integer DEFAULT 25, result_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, issue_id uuid, notice_number bigint, title text, notice_type text, act_referenced text, year integer, volume text, issue_number integer, issue_date date, rank real, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
      n.id,
      n.issue_id,
      n.notice_number::bigint AS notice_number,
      n.title::text,
      n.notice_type::text,
      n.act_referenced::text,
      g.year::integer,
      g.volume::text,
      g.issue_number::integer,
      g.date::date AS issue_date,
      ts_rank_cd(
        n.search_document,
        websearch_to_tsquery('english', search_query)
      )::real AS rank
    FROM public.gazette_notices n
    JOIN public.gazette_issues g
      ON g.id = n.issue_id
    WHERE btrim(COALESCE(search_query, '')) <> ''
      AND n.search_document @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', search_query)
      AND (filter_year IS NULL OR g.year = filter_year)
      AND (filter_issue_number IS NULL OR g.issue_number = filter_issue_number)
  )
  SELECT
    ranked.*,
    count(*) OVER ()::bigint AS total_count
  FROM ranked
  ORDER BY rank DESC, issue_date DESC, notice_number DESC
  LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(result_limit, 1), 100)
  OFFSET GREATEST(result_offset, 0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_legislation(p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_county_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_chamber text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_year integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(legal_document_id uuid, title text, short_title text, citation text, slug text, year integer, category text, status text, county_code text, originating_chamber text, href text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with filtered as (
    select
      d.id as legal_document_id,
      d.title,
      d.short_title,
      d.citation,
      d.slug,
      d.year,
      l.category,
      l.status,
      l.county_code,
      l.originating_chamber,
      l.act_number,
      l.assent_date,
      l.publication_date,
      l.commencement_date,
      case
        when l.category = 'act'
          then '/legislation/acts/' || d.slug
        when l.category = 'county_act'
          then '/legislation/counties/' ||
               coalesce(c.slug, lower(l.county_code)) || '/' || d.slug
        when l.category = 'subsidiary'
          then '/legislation/subsidiary/' || d.slug
        when l.category = 'treaty'
          then '/legislation/treaties/' || d.slug
        else '/legislation'
      end as href
    from public.legislation_documents l
    join public.legal_documents d
      on d.id = l.legal_document_id
    left join public.kenya_counties c
      on c.code = l.county_code
    where
      (p_category is null or l.category = p_category)
      and (p_status is null or l.status = p_status)
      and (p_county_code is null or l.county_code = p_county_code)
      and (p_chamber is null or l.originating_chamber = p_chamber)
      and (p_year is null or d.year = p_year)
      and (
        nullif(btrim(p_query), '') is null
        or d.title ilike '%' || btrim(p_query) || '%'
        or coalesce(d.short_title, '') ilike '%' || btrim(p_query) || '%'
        or coalesce(d.citation, '') ilike '%' || btrim(p_query) || '%'
        or coalesce(l.act_number, '') ilike '%' || btrim(p_query) || '%'
        or coalesce(l.cap_number, '') ilike '%' || btrim(p_query) || '%'
      )
  )
  select
    f.legal_document_id,
    f.title,
    f.short_title,
    f.citation,
    f.slug,
    f.year,
    f.category,
    f.status,
    f.county_code,
    f.originating_chamber,
    f.href,
    count(*) over() as total_count
  from filtered f
  order by
    f.year desc nulls last,
    f.assent_date desc nulls last,
    f.publication_date desc nulls last,
    f.commencement_date desc nulls last,
    f.title asc
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 30), 100))
  offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_public(q text, filter_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, lim integer DEFAULT 40)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, slug text, name text, snippet text, entity_type text, base_route text, rank double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  tsq tsquery;
  expanded_terms text;
BEGIN
  IF q IS NULL OR trim(q) = '' THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Expand using our Kenyan-specific expansions table (acronyms + misspellings)
  SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT expansion, ' ')
  INTO expanded_terms
  FROM public.search_expansions
  WHERE lower(trim(original)) = lower(trim(q));

  IF expanded_terms IS NOT NULL THEN
    q := q || ' ' || expanded_terms;
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('pg_trgm.similarity_threshold', '0.15', true);
  PERFORM set_config('pg_trgm.word_similarity_threshold', '0.1', true);

  tsq := websearch_to_tsquery('english', q);

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    v.id,
    v.slug,
    v.name,
    v.snippet,
    v.entity_type,
    v.base_route,
    (
      COALESCE(ts_rank(v.search_vector, tsq), 0) * v.rank_boost +
      GREATEST(
        word_similarity(q, coalesce(v.match_text, v.name)),
        word_similarity(q, coalesce(v.snippet, '')),
        similarity(coalesce(v.match_text, v.name), q) * 0.5
      ) * 2.0
    ) AS rank
  FROM public.global_search_view v
  WHERE 
    (filter_type IS NULL OR v.entity_type = filter_type)
    AND (
      v.search_vector @@ tsq
      OR word_similarity(q, coalesce(v.match_text, v.name)) >= 0.1
      OR (v.snippet IS NOT NULL AND word_similarity(q, v.snippet) >= 0.1)
      OR coalesce(v.match_text, v.name) % q
    )
  ORDER BY rank DESC
  LIMIT lim;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$
